summary: DirectBooking Technology Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 21, 2026, reporting a joint venture with Beijing DeepYou Digital Technology Co., Ltd. to form a new company focused on AI-powered travel and hospitality solutions. DirectBooking will hold 51% equity, DeepYou 49%. Former JD.com SVP Li Daxue will chair the new entity. No price, premium, board recommendation, or financial terms are disclosed. This is a routine business arrangement, not a special situation. The filing is a non-US issuer's current report.
